title: Potential of Artificial Intelligence Algorithms for Identification of Relevant Diagnostic and Prognostic Biomarkers of Early-Stage Liver Cancer
abstract: arXiv:2609.15638v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This study explores the use of deep learning and explainable artificial intelligence to diagnose hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) and define effective biomarkers across five different stages of disease development using a transcriptomic biomarker HCC dataset constructed via semi-supervised learning from three source datasets. Several deep learning experiments were conducted with different feature extraction techniques and gene sets to identify the most effective features for training high-accuracy models with minimal loss. The best-performing model, using 15 selected genes with the SelectKBest algorithm, achieved 90.74% accuracy, while the model with the lowest recorded loss of 0.3187 was obtained using 20 selected genes. translated_title: 人工智能算法在识别早期肝癌相关诊断和预后生物标志物方面的潜力
translated_abstract: 本研究探索了利用深度学习和可解释人工智能来诊断肝细胞癌（HCC），并通过半监督学习从三个源数据集构建的转录组生物标志物HCC数据集，定义疾病发展五个不同阶段的有效生物标志物。研究采用不同的特征提取技术和基因集进行了多项深度学习实验，以识别最有效的特征，从而训练出高精度且损失最小的模型。表现最佳的模型使用SelectKBest算法筛选出的15个基因，达到了90.74%的准确率，而记录到的最低损失0.3187则来自使用20个筛选基因的模型。为解决数据集中的类别不平衡问题，研究采用了加权训练方法；同时，为提高模型的透明度和可解释性，基于SHAP的可解释人工智能（XAI）分析为模型的决策过程提供了深入洞察。
tldr: 本研究利用深度学习结合SHAP可解释性分析识别早期肝癌的关键诊断生物标志物，仅用15个筛选基因即实现了90.74%的准确率，并通过可解释人工智能揭示了模型的决策依据。
en_tdlr: This study leverages deep learning and SHAP-based explainable AI to identify key diagnostic biomarkers for early-stage liver cancer, achieving 90.74% accuracy with only 15 selected genes while providing interpretability into the model's decision-making.
